title: Disposal of Crimes
notes: 2.2.1 Crime-head-wise disposal of the IPC cases by courts, in percentage term, may be seen in Table-16. It is seen that the highest percentage of cases (87.3) remained pending under the crime-head 'Criminal Breach Of Trust', closely followed by 'Cheating' (86.6). The crime-head 'Kidnapping & Abduction Of Others' (Other than women & girls) has the highest percentage of disposal of 22.9 (100 minus pending percentage). As mentioned in the above para, the total disposal was only 19.8 per cent comprising of 8 per cent cases of conviction, 8.8 per cent cases of acquittal and 3 per cent cases either compounded or withdrawn. Thus, after the cases were compounded or withdrawn, the cases which were actually tried, conviction was about 48 per cent ((Col.4/Col.6) * 100). Out of the cases in which trials were completed, more than half the cases under 'Theft' resulted in conviction whereas under all the other crime-heads the acquittal was more than the conviction.
